QF.id: XC Investment Products and Market Developments_5

question.text: A Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) offers which of the following advantages to an investor?

answer.text: Guaranteed returns higher than fixed deposits
Regular investing in fixed amounts that builds a corpus over time and provides rupee cost averaging
Tax-free returns regardless of the investment period
Elimination of all market risk through regular investments

explanation.text: The Logic: SIPs allow regular, fixed investments that build a corpus over time even from small sums, and they provide rupee cost averaging because more units are bought when prices are low and fewer when prices are high. Automating the SIP also helps the investor prioritise investment expenditure. The Trap: The source does not promise guaranteed returns, tax-free returns, or elimination of market risk; SIPs reduce the impact of timing but do not remove market risk. Note: Rupee cost averaging works through the SIP mechanism itself and does not depend on any specific minimum holding period to operate.
